form.label: Status
form.description: Health of the website-ping runner on each host that runs the inputs: heartbeat, load, starts, and whether every input still writes events. Runner panels read website_ping.log (index _internal); only roles that may search _internal see them.

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="website_ping:log" stanza="(process)" | stats count by host | sort 0 host

index=_internal sourcetype="website_ping:log" host=$host|s$ stanza="(process)" (message="heartbeat *" OR message="starting stanzas=*") | rex field=message "^heartbeat stanzas=(?<stanzas>\d+) in_flight=(?<in_flight>\d+) queued=(?<queued>\d+) late=(?<late>\d+) events=(?<events>\d+)" | rex field=message "^starting stanzas=\d+ invalid=(?<invalid>\d+) thread_limit=(?<thread_limit>\d+) pid=(?<pid>\d+) python=(?<python>\S+) openssl=\"(?<openssl>[^\"]*)\"" | eval heartbeat_time=if(isnotnull(in_flight), _time, null()), start_time=if(isnotnull(pid), _time, null()) | stats max(heartbeat_time) as last_heartbeat max(start_time) as started latest(stanzas) as stanzas latest(invalid) as invalid latest(thread_limit) as thread_limit latest(in_flight) as in_flight latest(queued) as queued latest(version) as version latest(python) as python latest(openssl) as openssl by host | eval silent=case(isnull(last_heartbeat), "no heartbeat", now() - last_heartbeat > 600, "yes", true(), "no") | `timesince(last_heartbeat,last_heartbeat)` | convert ctime(started) | table host silent last_heartbeat started stanzas invalid thread_limit in_flight queued version python openssl

chart.title: Runner load (average of the heartbeats; checks started late: total)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="website_ping:log" host=$host|s$ stanza="(process)" message="heartbeat *" | rex field=message "^heartbeat stanzas=\d+ in_flight=(?<in_flight>\d+) queued=(?<queued>\d+) late=(?<late>\d+) events=(?<events>\d+)" | timechart avg(in_flight) as checks_running avg(queued) as checks_waiting sum(late) as checks_started_late

chart.title: Check results per input (the 20 inputs with the most events, the rest as OTHER)

search.query: sourcetype="web_ping" `website_monitoring_search_index` | timechart limit=20 useother=true count by source

sourcetype="web_ping" `website_monitoring_search_index` | stats count as events range(_time) as span latest(_time) as last_event latest(title) as title by source host | eval usual_gap=if(events > 1, span / (events - 1), null()) | eval stale=case(isnull(usual_gap), "unknown", now() - last_event > 2 * usual_gap, "yes", true(), "no") | eval usual_interval=round(usual_gap, 0) | eval rank=case(stale=="yes", 0, stale=="unknown", 1, true(), 2) | sort 0 rank source | `timesince(last_event,last_event)` | table source title host stale last_event usual_interval events

index=_internal sourcetype="website_ping:log" host=$host|s$ stanza="(process)" (message="starting stanzas=*" OR message="stopped reason=*") | rex field=message "^starting stanzas=(?<stanzas>\d+) invalid=(?<invalid>\d+) thread_limit=(?<thread_limit>\d+) pid=(?<pid>\d+) python=(?<python>\S+) openssl=\"(?<openssl>[^\"]*)\"" | rex field=message "^stopped reason=(?<reason>.+?) pid=(?<stopped_pid>\d+) abandoned=(?<abandoned>\d+)" | eval what=if(isnotnull(reason), "stopped", "started"), pid=coalesce(pid, stopped_pid) | sort 0 -_time | table _time host what pid reason abandoned stanzas invalid thread_limit version python openssl
